chooseLanguageDescription: You can change it later in Preferences.
welcomeDescriptionWindows: SuperSonicCleaner scans temporary files, caches and registry entries, manages startup apps and shows the state of the system. Nothing changes without your confirmation.
welcomeDescriptionOther: SuperSonicCleaner scans temporary files and caches, manages startup apps and shows the state of the system. Nothing changes without your confirmation.
factPreview: A preview before every manual cleanup; cleaning without a preview asks for confirmation
factRegistryBackup: A registry backup before every fix
factAi: Optional AI analysis, on anonymous data only
recommendedSetupDescription: The recommended settings are on. You can change them at any time in Preferences.
runAtStartupDescriptionWindows: Opens SuperSonicCleaner when you sign in to Windows, so scheduled cleanups can run.
runAtStartupDescriptionOther: Opens SuperSonicCleaner when you sign in, so scheduled cleanups can run.
minimizeToTrayDescription: When you close the window, SuperSonicCleaner keeps running in the background.
weeklyAutoCleanDescription: Scans and cleans junk files every Monday at 9:00.
allSetDescription: Your choices are applied when you open Home. You can change them at any time in Preferences.
